# Lowyat.NET

> > Malaysia's premier technology and community forum covering computers, hardware, mobile devices, networking, and electronics marketplace

Lowyat.NET is an insanely addictive Malaysian forum that serves as a comprehensive hub for technology enthusiasts, featuring discussions on computer hardware (NVIDIA GeForce, Windows 11), mobile platforms (Android, Samsung Pay), networking solutions (WiFi, broadband), and an active marketplace for buying and selling electronics. The community covers everything from technical support to career opportunities, making it a central destination for Malaysia's tech-savvy population.

## Key Topics

- Windows 11
- Android
- NVIDIA GeForce
- Samsung Pay
- WiFi and Broadband
- Apple Macbook Air
- Core i5 processors
- Acer Nitro 5
- LCD/UHD/QHD displays
- Computer Hardware
- Networking Equipment
- Electronics Marketplace
- Tech Community Malaysia
- Second-hand Electronics

## Computer Hardware & Systems

- [Computers](https://forum.lowyat.net/Computers): Computer hardware and Windows 11 technical support forum section
- [Hardware](https://forum.lowyat.net/Hardware): Computer hardware discussions featuring NVIDIA GeForce and monitors

## Mobile & Android

- [Android](https://forum.lowyat.net/Android): Android mobile phones, tablets, and Samsung Pay discussion forum

## Networking & Connectivity

- [Networks and Broadband](https://forum.lowyat.net/NetworksandBroadband): Home networking, WiFi routers, and broadband discussion forum

## Marketplace & Trading

- [Garage Sales](https://forum.lowyat.net/GarageSales): Marketplace for buying and selling electronics like Acer Nitro 5
- [Notebooks Garage Sales](https://forum.lowyat.net/NotebooksGarageSales/+4560?tag=Notebooks+(Used)): Used notebooks marketplace featuring Apple Macbook Air and Core i5 laptops

## Community Hub

- [Lowyat.NET Homepage](https://forum.lowyat.net/): Homepage of Malaysia's leading tech and community forum

## Optional

- [Jobs & Careers](https://forum.lowyat.net/Jobs&Careers/+12540): Job listings and career discussions including Halliburton opportunities
